title: Toyota Sienna Custom Vinyl Wrap
description: A bold Toyota Sienna Custom Vinyl Wrap transforms the vehicle with vibrant colors and a sleek, personalized design. For more details, check out our blog!

blocks.alt: Oblique front view of a Toyota Sienna displaying a vinyl wrap

blocks.html:
Designers have created a custom vinyl wrap for a client, featuring vibrant orange and green colors to achieve a bold taxi cab look. Below are the project details, materials used, and visuals highlighting this impressive transformation.

Front view of a Toyota Sienna custom vinyl wrap

Project details of the Toyota Sienna Custom vinyl wrap

We used Wrap Authority as a template for the Toyota Sienna. The design was printed on a 1080 Series IJ 180 Printable Vinyl with Gloss Finish.

Our team collaborated with Vinyl Wrap Toronto for the installations.

If you’re looking to transform your vehicle, explore our custom car wraps. Contact us on our website.
